profile.headline: Full stack Developer at Knight Transportation

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Develop new business applications, APIs for Iseries with RPGLE, CL, SQL, Etc. 
Develop Web applications with Python Flask, VueJs. 
EDI/API development
Create detailed design, user, and technical documentation for new applications. 
Modify, detect, and fix bugs in older applications by rewriting or refactoring.

positions.title: Associate Application Developer
positions.description:
Develop RPGLE programs for account management/EDI. 
EDI development 
Set up AS2/SSH connections 
One week on call monthly
Python-Flask web development

positions.title: Software Application Developer
positions.description:
EDI development 
Iseries application development 
Web development

positions.title: Electronic Data Interchange Business Analyst
positions.description:
Plan, analyze, and implement EDI systems and processes
Analyze and interpret EDI transactions to ensure accuracy and compliance with standards.
Troubleshoot and resolve EDI errors and issues in a timely manner.
Provide training and support to internal stakeholders on EDI processes and systems.
Approve and review UAT testing
In training for RPGLE software development on IBM AS400 series systems.

positions.title: Account Manager
positions.description:
Managed Fortune 500 company accounts
Collaborated with internal teams, including Sales, Operations, and Customer Service, to ensure seamless execution of customer requirements.
Conducted regular business reviews with key stakeholders, providing insights, recommendations, and updates on account performance
Identified trends, Business opportunities, and risks. 
Led projects for clients with a high level of service and success.
Continually grew accounts year over year with revenues consistently exceeding over 10 million a year. 
Won awards from our customers consecutively for two years based on customer service.

positions.title: Account Manager
positions.description:
Manage a portfolio of national and regional accounts consisting of a wide range of Fortune 500 companies.
Provide logistical solutions to new customers.
Manage high email and phone traffic.
Upsell a wide range of services to new and existing customers
Create reports on a weekly basis to present to management
Build relationships with customers and communicate on a daily basis

positions.title: Compliance Auditor
positions.description:
Audit employer contributions to unions based on contracts
Analyze, report, & document the full audit process for legal purposes
Read and explain financial statements
Find discrepancies and investigate potential fraud or error
Use Microsoft Excel to create templates and forms for auditing process.
Data manipulation to ensure accurate reporting by eliminating the need for manual data entry

positions.title: Manager
positions.description:
Implement sales strategy to exceed sales quotas
Establish business relationships with business owners/corporations
Review timesheets, inventory, and ensure store was up to date
Manage and train employees in the sales process
Build relationships and manage business accounts with small business owners

positions.title: Receiver
positions.description:
Provided excellent customer service by advising customer on tools needed to complete projects. 
Ensured OSHA compliance & maintained hazard areas
Operated heavy equipment and reported any issues with upper management

positions.title: Sales Marketing Consultant
positions.description:
Created and implemented sales strategies to reach monthly goals. 
Traditional marketing through print, cold calling, and door to door. 
Social media/online marketing to boost online sales

positions.title: Sales Consultant
positions.description:
Use tools such as Salesforce to manage leads, conversions and cold calls.
Use Internal T-Mobile IT systems to manage accounts, billing and diagnose mobile network issues.
Provided excellent B2B solutions by establishing relationships
Created sales strategies to hit dynamic monthly goals

positions.title: Sales Consultant
positions.description:
Created sales strategies to hit monthly goals.
Managed accounts and set up Xfinity installations with contractors. 
Provided excellent customer service and knowledge of Xfinity products.
Increased B2B accounts and generated new leads for ComEd

positions.title: File Clerk
positions.description:
Organized documents
Data entry.
Managed the secure disposal of invoice data
Ensured compliance with state privacy laws

positions.title: Temporary Associate
positions.description:
Responsible for back room inventory, collateral, and stocking on the floor
Increased sales in the first weeks of opening as a new store
